purpose: Named medical education: CME/CPD, academies, certificate tracks, summer schools, and named observership/preceptorship. Separate from Burs (funding) and from unpaid generic staj until a staj lane exists.
audience: Turkish citizen, studying in Türkiye, or holding a Turkish passport, in an in-scope medical field.
hard_rules: Do not mix scholarship/fellowship funding sources into this lane — those stay burs_.
Named observership/preceptorship is in-scope for Eğitim.
Unpaid short clinical visit without a named programme stays out until staj lane.
Aggregator and consultancy course-mills are kapsam_disi.
Fail-closed: UNKNOWN application eligibility is not presented as an open call.
Three axes required on every egitim opportunity: application_eligibility, credential_recognition, practice_rights (YES|PARTIAL|NO|UNKNOWN|NOT_APPLICABLE).
Catalogue listing is not a TUK specialty, GETAT licence, or clinical practice right. Coaching credentials are not physician licences.
